fixes.fix: CLI --in-place/-o truncates file when options invalid or formatting fails
fixes.why: Output file was opened (truncated) before validation/formatting, so an error destroyed the user's input file (data loss).

fixes.fix: CLI reports decode errors instead of traceback
fixes.why: A non-UTF-8 input file crashed the CLI with an uncaught UnicodeDecodeError instead of the usual [ERROR] message and continuing.

fixes.fix: CLI --comma_first/--compact parse 'False' as True
fixes.why: type=bool turns any non-empty string including 'False' into True, so the documented option could not be turned off.

fixes.fix: Function.get_window AttributeError without OVER
fixes.why: token_next_by returns a truthy (None, None) tuple, so get_window() on a plain function raised AttributeError instead of returning None.

fixes.fix: Function.get_parameters inconsistent: generator vs list, drops single Operation/Case/wildcard/NULL
fixes.why: f(a, b+c) returned 'b + c' but f(b+c) returned [] and count(*) returned [], i.e. wrong results depending on parameter count.

fixes.fix: TypedLiteral not grouped into IdentifierList
fixes.why: "select date '2020-01-01', x" was not grouped as an IdentifierList, so the select list was mis-parsed.

fixes.fix: Window functions / 'x DESC' report bogus alias
fixes.why: get_alias() returned the function name / column itself for 'foo(x) over (...)' and 'col desc', a wrong result.

fixes.fix: Function grouping skipped for lowercase 'as' in CTAS
fixes.why: Case-sensitive 'AS' check skipped function grouping for 'create table t as select count(x)'.
fixes.upstream_commit: 111b35c Fix function grouping skipped for lowercase 'as' in CREATE TABLE AS SELECT

fixes.fix: truncate_strings breaks literals with escaped quotes
fixes.why: Literals starting with '' were mis-detected and cuts in the middle of '' / \' escapes produced unterminated, invalid SQL.

fixes.fix: Token types lose identity on copy/deepcopy/pickle
fixes.why: Copied/pickled statements got new tuple instances so identity-based checks (ttype is T.Keyword.DML, get_type()) silently failed.

fixes.fix: remove_quotes IndexError on empty string
fixes.why: Internal helper crash on '' with no demonstrated user-facing path; harmless hardening.

fixes.fix: parsestream accepts binary / non-TextIOBase file objects
fixes.why: Binary streams and codecs readers weren't supported before; reasonable but closer to a feature extension than a bug.

fixes.fix: Long operator chains exceed MAX_GROUPING_DEPTH (nested Operations)
fixes.why: A valid 'a || b || ...' with a few hundred terms raised SQLParseError because each operator nested one more level; fix flattens chains (changes tree shape).

fixes.fix: Quadratic runtime when extending groups (wide identifier lists)
fixes.why: grp.value = str(start) re-flattened the growing group on every extend, O(n^2) for thousands of columns.
fixes.upstream_commit: 939b129 set group value from child tokens to avoid quadratic grouping

fixes.fix: Incomplete 'x AS' / ':=' before punctuation swallows closing parenthesis
fixes.why: Grouping 'as )' moved the ')' out of the Parenthesis, producing a malformed tree that crashed reindent.

fixes.fix: Aligned reindent crash on CASE without END
fixes.why: reindent_aligned raised on a CASE whose END token is missing (None appended to cases).

fixes.fix: Statement splitting wrong at END REPEAT
fixes.why: MySQL 'end repeat;' inside a procedure was treated as END of the block, splitting the procedure incorrectly.

fixes.fix: strip_semicolon ignores semicolon followed by trailing comment
fixes.why: Whether a ';' before a trailing comment should be stripped is a policy choice; previous behaviour only stripped a final ';'.

fixes.fix: identifier_case changes backtick/bracket quoted identifiers
fixes.why: Double-quoted names were already excluded so extending to `x`/[x] is consistent, but quoted-identifier case sensitivity is dialect-dependent.

fixes.fix: Python/PHP output doesn't escape backslashes (PHP also '$')
fixes.why: A backslash before a quote could break out of the generated string literal (security advisory GHSA-3496-9g83-7v6x).

fixes.fix: Python/PHP output loses reindent line breaks nested in groups
fixes.why: Output filter only iterated top-level tokens, so newlines inserted by reindent inside groups were not converted into string-continuation lines.

fixes.fix: reindent_aligned validation message shows wrong value
fixes.why: Error message interpolated the reindent value instead of reindent_aligned; the error is still raised, purely cosmetic.
